categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily designs, develops, and sells display driver ICs, timing controller ICs (TCON), power management ICs (PMIC), LED driver ICs, touch ICs, and EEPROMs. Its products serve various panel technologies including a-Si, Oxide, LTPS, AMOLED, LED, and CH-LCD. The business segments cover large-size panels for notebooks, monitors, and TVs, as well as medium and small-size panels for smartphones, wearables, tablets, and automotive displays.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced semiconductor design technologies including high-voltage circuit design, mixed-signal circuit design, image processing algorithms, and touch system integration. It develops integrated solutions such as TDDI, TED, LTDI, and supports advanced display technologies like AMOLED, LTPO, Mini/Micro LED, and CH-LCD. Manufacturing is outsourced to wafer foundries and packaging/testing subcontractors, while the company concentrates on IC design and development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major panel manufacturers and brand companies in Taiwan, China, Japan, and Korea. The end markets served are diverse, including consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, notebooks, monitors, TVs), wearable devices, automotive displays (HUD, CID, cluster, e-mirror), and industrial applications. The company holds a leading market position in AMOLED driver ICs for wearables and is among the top three suppliers for large-size panel driver ICs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with significant sales in Mainland China (including Hong Kong) accounting for nearly 80% of revenue. It also serves customers in Taiwan and other countries. The company has established subsidiaries and operational bases in China to provide localized services and support.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segment of the display supply chain as an IC design house. It designs critical semiconductor components (driver ICs, TCON, PMIC) for display panels but outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors. It collaborates closely with panel manufacturers and brand customers in product development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AMOLED technology, expanding into automotive display products, and advancing new display technologies such as Micro LED, Mini LED, and CH-LCD. The company emphasizes low power consumption, high refresh rates, integration of touch and display functions, and development of high-resolution and high-performance ICs. It invests heavily in R&D (16% of revenue) to maintain technological leadership and develop next-generation products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor ICs designed for display applications. The company sells customized driver ICs, timing controllers, power management ICs, and integrated solutions to panel manufacturers and brand customers. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on volume sales and long-term customer partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the top three suppliers of large-size panel driver ICs globally, excluding Korean panel makers who use in-house IC suppliers. It holds a leading position in the AMOLED driver IC market, especially for wearables and smartphones, competing with other Taiwanese and Chinese IC design firms. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, close customer collaboration, and advanced technology integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$24.38 billion, a 32.9% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$2.1 billion, up 45.5%. The company maintains a strong financial position with total assets of about NT$20.4 billion and equity of NT$12.1 billion. R&D expenses accounted for 16% of revenue, reflecting a robust growth and investment profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced technology leadership in AMOLED and other emerging display technologies, offering highly integrated, low-power, and high-performance IC solutions. It provides comprehensive product portfolios covering large to small panel sizes and integrates touch and display functions to simplify customer designs. Strong collaboration with key panel manufacturers and brand customers enables tailored solutions and rapid innovation, ensuring high quality, reliability, and competitive cost structures.
